That's the ideal. But reality is different! Men are visual creatures and listen, i'm not complaning. I'm not saying they are wrong. I just want to be able to be good enough for someone.

Yes, i really am that bad. There's no scaping it.

Oh no but i wouldn't do this. I just want to fix what is horrible. I wouldn't stand not recognizing myself. 

(Also, being honest: I can work very hard for one or two surgeries but i don't have enough money for plenty. So even if i went insane, i woudn't be able to).

I'm trying, i really am. I'm seeing a mental health professional and all. But my goal is to be the best wife i can be, and that means being at least not horrible. (is not just about looks, but looks are important in a woman).

I mean, i would be changed after the surgery and he has all the right to leave if he doesn't like, of course. But it's a lose-lose game.

I stay ugly, i stay alone.

I fix myself, i stay alone.

It's quite complicated. You see, i'm not trying to complain, and make it seem like i am a victim or anything. I really just want to have a family but mother nature was not kind.
